title: Kebabbivori
excerpt: Kebab reviews across the province of Varese, scored in ten categories including the grease factor.

data.text: Seriously reviewing the kebab shops of the province of Varese, with a group of amateur reviewers. Ten rating categories (meat, bread, sauces, fries, service and, of course, the grease factor), a map of the places and reviewer profiles.
Next.js and Supabase. The site is still online.

image_captions: Kebab review platform with interactive map and advanced 10-category rating system
